title: Deep Learning for Leaf Disease Recognition in Rice and Maize: A Systematic Review of Vision Tasks and an Audit of Data Leakage in Model Evaluation
description: Search records, screening decisions, full-text assessment, coding of 202 included studies, evidence tables, near-duplicate measurements of six public datasets, controlled leakage experiments with per-seed split manifests, the supplementary material and PRISMA 2020 checklist of the paper, and the list of checks run against every reported number (number_checks.txt). Data only: the analysis code is available from the authors on request. Review protocol: OSF Registries 10.17605/OSF.IO/FWZ4S.

creators.name: Tong-Le, Thanh-Hai
creators.affiliation: Tien Giang University; Tra Vinh University

creators.name: Doan, Thanh-Nghi
creators.affiliation: An Giang University; Vietnam National University Ho Chi Minh City

notes: Data CC BY 4.0. The analysis code is not published and is available from the authors on request. Full texts of the reviewed articles are not redistributed. Version 1.4.0 (submission version): per-seed split manifests of all 140 runs of the controlled experiment with SHA-256 checksums of every image (leakage_experiments/split_manifests/; regenerated splits reproduce the set sizes of every run); the supplementary material and PRISMA 2020 checklist are the English versions that accompany the submitted manuscript; reference metadata corrected. number_checks.txt has 68 checks, all passing.
